q_vocab_b2_01_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'el sufragio' en Español?
q_vocab_b2_01_001.explanation: 'El sufragio' significa 'suffrage' o 'el/la correcto a vote'. Ello es a fundamental concept en democratic systems, referring a citizens' ability a participate en elections.

q_vocab_b2_01_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'el escaño' en a political context?
q_vocab_b2_01_002.explanation: 'El escaño' se refiere a a seat en parliament o congress. Cuando a party wins elections, ellos gain 'escaños' en el/la legislative body.

q_vocab_b2_01_003.question: El parlamento aprobó una nueva ___ sobre educación.
q_vocab_b2_01_003.explanation: 'Ley' significa 'law'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la parliament approved a nuevo law en education.' Laws son approved through el/la legislative process.

q_vocab_b2_01_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la dictadura' ?
q_vocab_b2_01_004.explanation: 'La dictadura' significa 'dictatorship', a form de government donde power es held por one persona o a pequeño group without democratic elections.

q_vocab_b2_01_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'el mandato' en political language?
q_vocab_b2_01_005.explanation: 'El mandato' se refiere a a political mandate o term en office. Por ejemplo, 'un mandato presidencial de cuatro años' significa 'a four-años presidential term'.

q_vocab_b2_01_006.question: democracy
q_vocab_b2_01_006.explanation: 'Democracy' translates a 'la democracia' en español. Ello derives from Greek y se refiere a government por el/la personas.

q_vocab_b2_01_007.question: Which Español word means 'a overthrow' a government?
q_vocab_b2_01_007.explanation: 'Derrocar' significa 'a overthrow' specifically en el/la context de removing a government from power. 'Derrochar' significa a waste, 'derretir' significa a melt, y 'derribar' significa a knock down (a building).

q_vocab_b2_01_008.question: el golpe de estado
q_vocab_b2_01_008.explanation: 'El golpe de estado' literalmente translates a 'blow al state' y significa 'coup d'etat' -- an illegal seizure de power from a government.

q_vocab_b2_01_009.question: A citizen wants a express dissatisfaction with nuevo tax policies. Which action would they tomar en a democracy?
q_vocab_b2_01_009.correct: Presentar una queja formal ante el gobierno.
wrong: Dejar de trabajar como protesta individual.
q_vocab_b2_01_009.explanation: 'Presentar una queja formal' significa 'a file a formal complaint'. En a democracy, citizens tener el/la correcto a formally expresar dissatisfaction through legal channels.

q_vocab_b2_01_010.question: A news anchor reports that a candidate tiene won the election. Which frase would they use?
q_vocab_b2_01_010.correct: El candidato ha obtenido la mayoría de los votos.
wrong: El candidato ha perdido todas las elecciones.
El candidato ha dimitido de su cargo.
El candidato ha sido destituido por corrupción.
q_vocab_b2_01_010.explanation: 'Obtener la mayoría de los votos' significa 'a obtain el/la majority de votes'. Esto es el/la standard way a announce an election victory en español news.

q_vocab_b2_02_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la ética' ?
q_vocab_b2_02_001.explanation: 'La ética' significa 'ethics', el/la branch de philosophy dealing with moral principles eso govern behavior y decision-making.

q_vocab_b2_02_002.question: El filósofo desarrolló una nueva ___ sobre la existencia humana.
q_vocab_b2_02_002.explanation: 'Teoría' significa 'theory'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la philosopher developed a nuevo theory about human existence.'

q_vocab_b2_02_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'el razonamiento' ?
q_vocab_b2_02_003.explanation: 'El razonamiento' significa 'reasoning', el/la process de thinking logically para formar conclusions. Ello viene de 'razón' (reason).

q_vocab_b2_02_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la conciencia' en a philosophical context?
q_vocab_b2_02_004.explanation: 'La conciencia' can significar ambos 'consciousness' (awareness de one's existence) y 'conscience' (moral awareness). Context determines cual significado applies.

q_vocab_b2_02_005.question: free will
q_vocab_b2_02_005.explanation: 'Free will' translates a 'el libre albedrío' en español. Ello es a central concept en philosophy, debating whether humans truly tener freedom de choice.

q_vocab_b2_02_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'la moral' mean when used as a noun?
wrong: the moral of a story only
q_vocab_b2_02_006.explanation: 'La moral' as un sustantivo significa 'morality' (el/la principles de correcto y incorrecto) o 'morale' (emotional state). As un adjetivo, 'moral' significa 'moral'.

q_vocab_b2_02_007.question: A philosophy professor asks students a question whether reality is truly as we perceive it. Which concept is being discussed?
q_vocab_b2_02_007.explanation: 'El escepticismo' (skepticism) es el/la philosophical position eso preguntas el/la possibility de certain knowledge. Ello challenges assumptions about perception y reality.

q_vocab_b2_02_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'la virtud' ?
q_vocab_b2_02_008.explanation: 'La virtud' significa 'virtue', a quality considered morally bueno. En classical philosophy, Aristotle emphasized virtues como courage, justice, y temperance.

q_vocab_b2_02_009.question: el dilema moral
q_vocab_b2_02_009.explanation: 'El dilema moral' significa 'moral dilemma', a situation donde a persona debe choose between two conflicting moral principles.

q_vocab_b2_02_010.question: En a debate about artificial intelligence, a philosopher argues that machines cannot truly think. Which philosophical concept supports this view?
q_vocab_b2_02_010.correct: El dualismo mente-cuerpo: la mente es más que procesos físicos.
wrong: El materialismo: todo es materia física.
El empirismo: solo importa la experiencia.
El pragmatismo: lo que funciona es verdad.
q_vocab_b2_02_010.explanation: Mind-body dualism ('el dualismo mente-cuerpo') holds eso el/la mind es fundamentally diferente de el/la physical body, suggesting consciousness no puede ser replicated por machines.
q_vocab_b2_02_010.context: Philosophical debate about AI and consciousness

q_vocab_b2_03_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la narrativa' en literary criticism?
q_vocab_b2_03_001.explanation: 'La narrativa' se refiere a narrative literature o fiction as a genre. Ello encompasses novels, short stories, y other prose fiction.

q_vocab_b2_03_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la metáfora' ?
q_vocab_b2_03_002.explanation: 'La metáfora' significa 'metaphor', a figure de speech eso describir algo por comparing ello a algo else without using 'como' o 'as'.

q_vocab_b2_03_003.question: El autor utiliza la ___ para crear tensión en la trama.
q_vocab_b2_03_003.explanation: 'Ironía' significa 'irony'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la author uses irony a create tension en el/la plot.' Irony es a key literary device.

q_vocab_b2_03_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'el desenlace' en the context de a story?
q_vocab_b2_03_004.explanation: 'El desenlace' se refiere a el/la resolution o terminación de a story, donde conflicts son resolved y el/la plot reaches su conclusion.

q_vocab_b2_03_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'el ensayo' en a literary context?
q_vocab_b2_03_005.explanation: 'El ensayo' en literature significa 'essay', a written composition en a particular topic. Fíjate en que 'ensayo' can también significar 'rehearsal' en performing arts contexts.

q_vocab_b2_03_006.question: short story
q_vocab_b2_03_006.explanation: 'Short story' translates a 'el cuento' en español. Ser careful not a confuse ello with 'la cuenta' (el/la bill/account) o 'el descuento' (el/la discount).

q_vocab_b2_03_007.question: Which Español term refers a the main character en a literary work?
q_vocab_b2_03_007.explanation: 'El/la protagonista' significa 'el/la protagonist' o main character. El/la opposing character es 'el/la antagonista'. note: 'protagonista' puede ser masculino o femenino.

q_vocab_b2_03_008.question: el género literario
q_vocab_b2_03_008.explanation: 'El género literario' significa 'literary genre', referring a categories de literature como poetry, drama, fiction, y essay.

q_vocab_b2_03_009.question: A book reviewer wants para decir that a novel tiene an unreliable narrator. How would they express this concept?
q_vocab_b2_03_009.correct: La novela presenta un narrador poco fiable.
wrong: La novela no tiene ningún narrador.
La novela es una biografía del autor.
q_vocab_b2_03_009.explanation: 'Narrador poco fiable' significa 'unreliable narrator'. Esto es un literary technique donde el/la narrator's credibility es compromised, making el/la reader pregunta el/la story's truth.
q_vocab_b2_03_009.context: Writing a literary review for a newspaper

q_vocab_b2_03_010.question: A literature student needs para describir the recurring theme de isolation en a novel. Which frase is most appropriate?
q_vocab_b2_03_010.correct: El tema recurrente de la soledad permea toda la obra.
wrong: El libro es muy largo y aburrido.
La soledad es mala para la salud.
El autor vive solo en una casa grande.
q_vocab_b2_03_010.explanation: 'El tema recurrente' significa 'el/la recurring theme'. 'Permear toda la obra' significa 'a permeate el/la entire work'. Esto es formal literary criticism idioma.

q_vocab_b2_04_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la estrategia de mercado' ?
q_vocab_b2_04_001.explanation: 'La estrategia de mercado' significa 'market strategy', el/la plan a company develops a reach su target consumers y achieve competitive advantage.

q_vocab_b2_04_002.question: La empresa lanzó una campaña para mejorar su ___ de marca.
q_vocab_b2_04_002.explanation: 'Imagen de marca' significa 'brand image'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la company launched a campaign a improve su brand image.'

q_vocab_b2_04_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'la competencia' en a business context?
q_vocab_b2_04_003.explanation: 'La competencia' en business significa 'el/la competition', referring a rival companies. Ello can también significar 'competence' (ability) en other contexts.

q_vocab_b2_04_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la negociación' ?
q_vocab_b2_04_004.explanation: 'La negociación' significa 'negotiation', el/la process de discussing terms a reach a business agreement between parties.

q_vocab_b2_04_005.question: profit margin
q_vocab_b2_04_005.explanation: 'Profit margin' translates a 'el margen de beneficio' en español. Ello represents el/la percentage de revenue eso becomes profit después de expenses.

q_vocab_b2_04_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'la cuota de mercado' ?
q_vocab_b2_04_006.explanation: 'La cuota de mercado' significa 'market share', el/la percentage de total sales en a market captured por a particular company o product.

q_vocab_b2_04_007.question: A company is preparing a enter a nuevo foreign market. Which step should they tomar first?
q_vocab_b2_04_007.correct: Realizar un estudio de mercado del país objetivo.
wrong: Despedir a todos los empleados actuales.
q_vocab_b2_04_007.explanation: 'Realizar un estudio de mercado' significa 'a conduct market research'. Antes de entering a nuevo market, companies debe understand local consumer behavior, competition, y regulations.

q_vocab_b2_04_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'el emprendedor' ?
q_vocab_b2_04_008.explanation: 'El emprendedor' significa 'entrepreneur', a persona quién creates y runs a nuevo business, taking en financial risks en hope de profit.

q_vocab_b2_04_009.question: la fusión empresarial
q_vocab_b2_04_009.explanation: 'La fusión empresarial' significa 'business merger', cuando two o more companies combine para formar a single entity.

q_vocab_b2_04_010.question: During a business negotiation, the other party hace an offer below your minimum acceptable price. ¿Qué es the most professional response?
q_vocab_b2_04_010.correct: Presentar una contraoferta con justificación detallada.
wrong: Aceptar inmediatamente para cerrar el trato.
Abandonar la reunión sin decir nada.
Insultar la propuesta de la otra parte.
q_vocab_b2_04_010.explanation: 'Presentar una contraoferta' significa 'a present a counteroffer'. En professional negotiations, responding with a justified counteroffer maintains el/la dialogue y muestra preparedness.

q_vocab_b2_05_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'el especialista' en a medical context?
q_vocab_b2_05_001.explanation: 'El especialista' significa 'specialist', a doctor quién focuses en a specific area de medicine, como cardiology o neurology.

q_vocab_b2_05_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la cirugía' ?
q_vocab_b2_05_002.explanation: 'La cirugía' significa 'surgery', a medical procedure involving an incision a repair, remove, o replace part del body.

q_vocab_b2_05_003.question: El paciente fue ingresado en la ___ de urgencias.
q_vocab_b2_05_003.explanation: 'Sala de urgencias' significa 'emergency room'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la patient fue admitted al emergency room.' 'Ingresar' significa a ser admitted a hospital.

q_vocab_b2_05_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'el seguro médico' ?
q_vocab_b2_05_004.explanation: 'El seguro médico' significa 'health insurance', coverage eso pays para medical expenses. 'Seguro' can significar ambos 'insurance' y 'safe/secure'.

q_vocab_b2_05_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'el diagnóstico' ?
q_vocab_b2_05_005.explanation: 'El diagnóstico' significa 'diagnosis', el/la identification de a disease o condition based en symptoms y medical tests.

q_vocab_b2_05_006.question: medical prescription
q_vocab_b2_05_006.explanation: 'Medical prescription' translates a 'la receta médica'. Fíjate en que 'receta' también significa 'recipe' en cooking contexts.

q_vocab_b2_05_007.question: Which Español term means 'outpatient' (a patient who receives care without being admitted overnight)?
q_vocab_b2_05_007.explanation: 'Paciente ambulatorio' significa 'outpatient', alguien quién visits a hospital para treatment pero no stay overnight. El/la opposite es 'paciente interno' (inpatient).

q_vocab_b2_05_008.question: la rehabilitación
q_vocab_b2_05_008.explanation: 'La rehabilitación' significa 'rehabilitation', el/la process de restoring health y function through therapy después de illness, injury, o surgery.

q_vocab_b2_05_009.question: A patient arrives en the hospital with chest pain. The doctor orders immediate tests. ¿Qué es the correct medical term para this situation?
q_vocab_b2_05_009.correct: Es una emergencia cardíaca; hay que hacer un electrocardiograma.
wrong: Es una gripe; hay que descansar en casa.
Es una alergia; hay que tomar antihistamínicos.
Es un dolor muscular; hay que hacer ejercicio.
q_vocab_b2_05_009.explanation: 'Emergencia cardíaca' significa 'cardiac emergency'. An 'electrocardiograma' (ECG) es a standard test a evaluate heart function en emergency situations.
q_vocab_b2_05_009.context: Hospital emergency room with acute symptoms

q_vocab_b2_05_010.question: A nurse explains a a patient's family that the patient needs a stay en the hospital para further observation. Which frase is most appropriate?
q_vocab_b2_05_010.correct: El paciente debe permanecer ingresado para observación.
wrong: El paciente puede irse a casa ahora mismo.
El paciente no necesita ningún tratamiento.
El paciente debe buscar otro hospital.
q_vocab_b2_05_010.explanation: 'Permanecer ingresado para observación' significa 'a remain hospitalized para observation'. Esto es standard medical terminology para keeping a patient under monitoring.
q_vocab_b2_05_010.context: Nurse communicating with patient's family at the hospital

q_vocab_b2_06_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la inteligencia artificial' ?
q_vocab_b2_06_001.explanation: 'La inteligencia artificial' (IA en español, AI en inglés) significa 'artificial intelligence', el/la simulation de human intelligence por computer systems.

q_vocab_b2_06_002.question: Los hackers intentaron vulnerar la ___ de la empresa.
q_vocab_b2_06_002.explanation: 'Ciberseguridad' significa 'cybersecurity'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la hackers tried a breach el/la company's cybersecurity.' Ello se refiere a protecting digital systems from attacks.

q_vocab_b2_06_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'la nube' en a technology context?
q_vocab_b2_06_003.explanation: 'La nube' literalmente significa 'el/la cloud' y en technology se refiere a 'cloud computing' -- storing y accessing data sobre el/la internet rather than en local hardware.

q_vocab_b2_06_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'el algoritmo' ?
q_vocab_b2_06_004.explanation: 'El algoritmo' significa 'algorithm', a set de reglas o instructions eso a computer follows a solve a problem o complete a task.

q_vocab_b2_06_005.question: database
q_vocab_b2_06_005.explanation: 'Database' translates a 'la base de datos' en español. Ello es a structured collection de data stored y accessed electronically.

q_vocab_b2_06_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'el cifrado' en cybersecurity?
q_vocab_b2_06_006.explanation: 'El cifrado' significa 'encryption', el/la process de converting data into a coded format a prevent unauthorized access. 'Cifrar' significa 'a encrypt'.

q_vocab_b2_06_007.question: A company wants a protect its employees from email fraud. What technology term describes this threat?
q_vocab_b2_06_007.explanation: 'El phishing' o 'suplantación de identidad' se refiere a fraudulent attempts a obtain sensitive information por disguising as a trustworthy entity en electronic communication.

q_vocab_b2_06_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'el aprendizaje automático' ?
q_vocab_b2_06_008.explanation: 'El aprendizaje automático' significa 'machine learning', a subset de AI donde systems learn y improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.

q_vocab_b2_06_009.question: la cadena de bloques
q_vocab_b2_06_009.explanation: 'La cadena de bloques' literalmente significa 'chain de blocks' y es el/la Español term para 'blockchain', a decentralized digital ledger technology.

q_vocab_b2_06_010.question: A startup is choosing between storing data en local servers o using cloud services. Which argument favors cloud computing?
q_vocab_b2_06_010.correct: La computación en la nube ofrece escalabilidad y reduce costos de infraestructura.
wrong: Los servidores locales son siempre más baratos.
La nube no permite almacenar datos grandes.
La computación en la nube no requiere conexión a internet.
q_vocab_b2_06_010.explanation: 'Escalabilidad' significa 'scalability' y 'infraestructura' significa 'infrastructure'. Cloud computing allows businesses a scale resources up o down as needed without investing en physical hardware.
q_vocab_b2_06_010.context: Tech startup evaluating IT infrastructure options

q_vocab_b2_07_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la desigualdad' ?
q_vocab_b2_07_001.explanation: 'La desigualdad' significa 'inequality', el/la state de not being equal, especialmente en terms de status, rights, o opportunities.

q_vocab_b2_07_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la discriminación' ?
q_vocab_b2_07_002.explanation: 'La discriminación' significa 'discrimination', el/la unjust treatment de different categories de personas based en race, age, género, o other characteristics.

q_vocab_b2_07_003.question: Los activistas organizaron una ___ pacífica en la plaza central.
q_vocab_b2_07_003.explanation: 'Manifestación' significa 'demonstration' o 'protest'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la activists organized a peaceful demonstration en el/la central square.'

q_vocab_b2_07_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'el refugiado' ?
q_vocab_b2_07_004.explanation: 'El refugiado' significa 'refugee', a persona quién tiene sido forced a leave su country a escape war, persecution, o natural disaster.

q_vocab_b2_07_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'la brecha salarial' ?
q_vocab_b2_07_005.explanation: 'La brecha salarial' significa 'wage gap' o 'pay gap', el/la difference en earnings between different groups, a menudo discussed en el/la context de género inequality.

q_vocab_b2_07_006.question: human rights
q_vocab_b2_07_006.explanation: 'Human rights' translates a 'los derechos humanos'. No confuse with 'recursos humanos' (human resources, el/la HR department).

q_vocab_b2_07_007.question: Which Español expression means 'social exclusion'?
q_vocab_b2_07_007.explanation: 'La exclusión social' significa 'social exclusion', el/la process por cual individuals o groups son blocked from participating fully en society.

q_vocab_b2_07_008.question: la xenofobia
q_vocab_b2_07_008.explanation: 'La xenofobia' significa 'xenophobia', el/la fear o hatred de personas from other countries o cultures.

q_vocab_b2_07_009.question: A community organization wants a help newly arrived immigrants integrate. Which initiative would be most effective?
q_vocab_b2_07_009.correct: Ofrecer programas de integración cultural y clases de idioma.
wrong: Prohibir que los inmigrantes salgan de su barrio.
Ignorar las necesidades de los recién llegados.
q_vocab_b2_07_009.explanation: 'Programas de integración cultural' significa 'cultural integration programs'. Helping immigrants learn el/la idioma y understand local culture es key a successful integration.
q_vocab_b2_07_009.context: Community organization planning immigrant support services

q_vocab_b2_07_010.question: An NGO publishes a report about poverty en urban areas. Which term describes people living below the minimum standard de living?
q_vocab_b2_07_010.correct: personas en situación de pobreza extrema
wrong: personas que viven en el campo
q_vocab_b2_07_010.explanation: 'Personas en situación de pobreza extrema' significa 'personas en extreme poverty'. Esto formal phrasing se usa en reports y policy documents para describir esos living below subsistence level.

q_vocab_b2_08_001.question: ¿Qué significa the idiom 'estar en las nubes' ?
q_vocab_b2_08_001.correct: to be daydreaming / to have one's head in the clouds
q_vocab_b2_08_001.explanation: 'Estar en las nubes' literalmente significa 'a ser en el/la clouds' y idiomatically significa a ser daydreaming o not paying attention.

q_vocab_b2_08_002.question: no entiendo nada de física cuántica; para mí es ___ con siete sellos.
q_vocab_b2_08_002.explanation: 'Ser un libro con siete sellos' significa 'a ser a closed book' o algo incomprehensible. El/la full idiom significa 'El/la topic es a complete mystery a me.'

q_vocab_b2_08_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'meter la pata' ?
q_vocab_b2_08_003.correct: to put one's foot in it / to make a blunder
wrong: to put one's leg in a hole
to step on an animal's paw
q_vocab_b2_08_003.explanation: 'Meter la pata' literalmente significa 'a put el/la paw en' y idiomatically significa para hacer a mistake o blunder, especialmente por saying algo inappropriate.

q_vocab_b2_08_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'tomar el pelo a alguien' ?
q_vocab_b2_08_004.correct: to pull someone's leg / to tease someone
q_vocab_b2_08_004.explanation: 'Tomar el pelo a alguien' literalmente significa 'para tomar alguien's hair' pero idiomatically significa a tease o hacer fun de alguien, similar a 'pulling alguien's leg'.

q_vocab_b2_08_005.question: a cost an arm and a leg (ser/estar very expensive)
q_vocab_b2_08_005.correct: costar un ojo de la cara
wrong: costar un brazo y una pierna
costar una mano y un pie
q_vocab_b2_08_005.explanation: 'Costar un ojo de la cara' literalmente significa 'a cost an eye from el/la face' y es el/la Español equivalent de 'a cost an arm y a leg'. Cada idioma tiene su own body-part metaphor para high cost.

q_vocab_b2_08_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'no tener pelos en la lengua' ?
q_vocab_b2_08_006.correct: to be outspoken / to not mince words
q_vocab_b2_08_006.explanation: 'no tener pelos en la lengua' literalmente significa 'a not tener hairs en el/la tongue' y significa a speak frankly y directamente without holding back.

q_vocab_b2_08_007.question: Your friend just told you they won the lottery, but you suspect they are joking. Which idiom would you use?
q_vocab_b2_08_007.explanation: '¡Me estás tomando el pelo!' significa 'Tú're pulling my leg!' o 'Tú're kidding me!' Ello expresa disbelief en qué seems como a joke.
q_vocab_b2_08_007.context: Casual conversation with a friend who shares surprising news

q_vocab_b2_08_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'dar en el clavo' ?
q_vocab_b2_08_008.correct: to hit the nail on the head / to get it exactly right
wrong: to hammer a nail into wood
q_vocab_b2_08_008.explanation: 'Dar en el clavo' literalmente significa 'a hit el/la nail' y idiomatically significa para obtener algo exactly correcto, just como el/la Inglés 'a hit el/la nail en el/la head'.

q_vocab_b2_08_009.question: echar leña al fuego
q_vocab_b2_08_009.correct: to add fuel to the fire / to make things worse
q_vocab_b2_08_009.explanation: 'Echar leña al fuego' literalmente significa 'a throw wood en el/la fire' y idiomatically significa para hacer a malo situation worse, equivalent a 'adding fuel al fire'.

q_vocab_b2_08_010.question: Two coworkers are gossiping about a colleague's mistake. A third coworker arrives and dice algo that hace the situation more tense. Which idiom describes what the tercera persona did?
q_vocab_b2_08_010.correct: Echó leña al fuego con su comentario.
wrong: Dio en el clavo con su comentario.
Estuvo en las nubes durante la conversación.
Tomó el pelo a sus compañeros.
q_vocab_b2_08_010.explanation: 'Echar leña al fuego' significa 'a add fuel al fire'. El/la tercero coworker's comment hizo el/la already tense gossip situation even worse.
q_vocab_b2_08_010.context: Workplace conflict escalated by an ill-timed comment

q_vocab_b2_09_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la tesis' en an academic context?
q_vocab_b2_09_001.explanation: 'La tesis' significa 'thesis' o 'dissertation', a substantial academic work submitted para a degree, presenting el/la author's research y findings.

q_vocab_b2_09_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la hipótesis' ?
q_vocab_b2_09_002.explanation: 'La hipótesis' significa 'hypothesis', a proposed explanation para a phenomenon eso puede ser tested through research y experimentation.

q_vocab_b2_09_003.question: El investigador describió la ___ utilizada para recopilar los datos.
q_vocab_b2_09_003.explanation: 'Metodología' significa 'methodology'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la researcher described el/la methodology se usa para collect el/la data.' Methodology explains cómo research es conducted.

q_vocab_b2_09_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la cita bibliográfica' ?
wrong: a romantic date at a library
q_vocab_b2_09_004.explanation: 'La cita bibliográfica' significa 'bibliographic citation', a reference a a source se usa en academic writing. 'Cita' significa ambos 'citation' y 'appointment/date'.

q_vocab_b2_09_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'el marco teórico' en a research paper?
q_vocab_b2_09_005.explanation: 'El marco teórico' significa 'theoretical framework', el/la structure de concepts y theories eso supports y informs academic research.

q_vocab_b2_09_006.question: peer review
q_vocab_b2_09_006.explanation: 'Peer review' translates a 'la revisión por pares'. 'Pares' significa 'peers' (equals). No confuse with 'padres' (parents), 'partes' (parts), o 'parejas' (couples).

q_vocab_b2_09_007.question: Which Español term means 'abstract' as en the summary en the beginning de an academic paper?
q_vocab_b2_09_007.explanation: 'El resumen' (o borrowed 'el abstract') es el/la brief summary en el/la beginning de an academic paper. 'Lo abstracto' significa 'el/la abstract' as en abstract art/concepts.

q_vocab_b2_09_008.question: las conclusiones del estudio
q_vocab_b2_09_008.explanation: 'Las conclusiones del estudio' significa 'el/la conclusions del study', el/la final section de a research paper donde findings son summarized y interpreted.

q_vocab_b2_09_009.question: A professor asks a student a avoid plagiarism en their research paper. What must the student do?
q_vocab_b2_09_009.correct: Citar correctamente todas las fuentes utilizadas.
wrong: Copiar textos sin indicar la fuente.
Escribir solo opiniones personales sin investigar.
Entregar el trabajo de otro estudiante.
q_vocab_b2_09_009.explanation: 'Citar correctamente todas las fuentes' significa 'a correctamente cite todos sources used'. Proper citation es essential a avoid 'el plagio' (plagiarism) en academic work.

q_vocab_b2_09_010.question: A researcher needs para describir how they collected data from 500 participants. Which section de the paper should contain this information?
q_vocab_b2_09_010.correct: La sección de metodología debe describir el proceso de recopilación de datos.
wrong: La introducción debe contener todos los datos numéricos.
Las conclusiones deben explicar cómo se hizo la investigación.
El resumen debe incluir los cuestionarios completos.
q_vocab_b2_09_010.explanation: 'La sección de metodología' significa 'el/la methodology section'. Esto part de a research paper explains el/la research design, data collection methods, y analytical procedures.
q_vocab_b2_09_010.context: Writing a research paper for an academic journal

q_vocab_b2_10_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la retórica' ?
q_vocab_b2_10_001.explanation: 'La retórica' significa 'rhetoric', el/la art de effective o persuasive speaking o writing, especialmente el/la use de figures de speech y compositional techniques.

q_vocab_b2_10_002.question: El orador presentó un ___ convincente para apoyar su posición.
q_vocab_b2_10_002.explanation: 'Argumento' significa 'argument' (en el/la logical sense). El/la sentence significa 'El/la speaker presented a convincing argument a support su position.'

q_vocab_b2_10_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'refutar' en a debate?
q_vocab_b2_10_003.explanation: 'Refutar' significa 'a refute' o 'a disprove', a prove eso a statement o argument es incorrecto por presenting counter-evidence o logical reasoning.

q_vocab_b2_10_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la falacia' ?
q_vocab_b2_10_004.explanation: 'La falacia' significa 'fallacy', a mistaken belief o a flawed argument eso appears logical pero es actually based en faulty reasoning.

q_vocab_b2_10_005.question: a persuade
q_vocab_b2_10_005.explanation: 'A persuade' translates a 'persuadir' en español. No confuse with 'perseguir' (a chase/pursue), 'percibir' (a perceive), o 'permitir' (a permit).

q_vocab_b2_10_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'el contraargumento' ?
q_vocab_b2_10_006.explanation: 'El contraargumento' significa 'counterargument', an argument hizo en opposition a another argument, se usa para challenge o weaken el/la opposing position.

q_vocab_b2_10_007.question: A debater attacks their opponent's character instead de addressing the actual argument. What type de logical fallacy is this?
q_vocab_b2_10_007.explanation: 'Un ataque ad hominem' es a logical fallacy donde alguien attacks el/la persona making el/la argument rather than el/la argument itself. Ello's one del más común fallacies en debates.
q_vocab_b2_10_007.context: Formal debate competition at a university

q_vocab_b2_10_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'la premisa' en logical reasoning?
q_vocab_b2_10_008.explanation: 'La premisa' significa 'premise', a statement o proposition eso forms el/la basis para an argument o from cual a conclusion es drawn.

q_vocab_b2_10_009.question: el discurso persuasivo
q_vocab_b2_10_009.explanation: 'El discurso persuasivo' significa 'persuasive speech', a speech designed a convince el/la audience a adopt a particular viewpoint o tomar a specific action.

q_vocab_b2_10_010.question: En a debate about environmental policy, your opponent claims that since temperatures dropped last winter, global warming is false. How would you identifica this error en reasoning?
q_vocab_b2_10_010.correct: Es una falacia: usar un caso aislado para negar una tendencia general.
wrong: Es un argumento válido basado en evidencia.
Es una opinión personal sin importancia.
q_vocab_b2_10_010.explanation: Esto es un 'generalización apresurada' (hasty generalization) o cherry-picking fallacy -- using a single data point a deny a well-documented trend. identificaing fallacies es key a effective debate.
q_vocab_b2_10_010.context: Academic debate on climate change policy

q_vocab_b2_11_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la nostalgia' ?
q_vocab_b2_11_001.explanation: 'La nostalgia' significa 'nostalgia', a sentimental longing para el/la past, a menudo idealized. Ello combines sadness para ¿Qué es gone with warm memories.

q_vocab_b2_11_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la angustia' ?
q_vocab_b2_11_002.explanation: 'La angustia' significa 'anguish' o 'deep anxiety', an intense feeling de emotional distress eso va beyond ordinary worry o nervousness.

q_vocab_b2_11_003.question: Después de la pérdida, sintió una profunda ___ que no podía explicar.
q_vocab_b2_11_003.explanation: 'Melancolía' significa 'melancholy'. El/la sentence significa 'Después de el/la loss, ellos felt a deep melancholy ellos podría not explain.' Melancholy es a persistent, pensive sadness.

q_vocab_b2_11_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la empatía' ?
q_vocab_b2_11_004.explanation: 'La empatía' significa 'empathy', el/la ability a understand y share el/la feelings de another persona. Ello differs from 'simpatía' (sympathy/liking) y 'apatía' (apathy).

q_vocab_b2_11_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'la amargura' ?
q_vocab_b2_11_005.explanation: 'La amargura' significa 'bitterness' o 'resentment', a deep feeling de hurt y anger a menudo resulting from unfair treatment o disappointment.

q_vocab_b2_11_006.question: ser/estar overwhelmed (emotionally)
q_vocab_b2_11_006.explanation: 'A ser overwhelmed' translates a 'estar abrumado/a'. No confuse with 'aburrido' (bored), 'abrigado' (warmly dressed), o 'abstraído' (absent-minded).

q_vocab_b2_11_007.question: Which Español word describes the feeling de satisfaction from alguien else's misfortune?
q_vocab_b2_11_007.explanation: 'El regodeo' o 'la satisfacción maligna' describir taking pleasure en another's misfortune (similar a el/la German 'Schadenfreude'). Ello es el/la opposite de compassion.

q_vocab_b2_11_008.question: la añoranza
q_vocab_b2_11_008.explanation: 'La añoranza' significa 'longing' o 'yearning', a deep emotional desire para algo absent -- a persona, lugar, o tiempo. Similar a nostalgia pero more focused en missing algo specific.

q_vocab_b2_11_009.question: A friend confides that they feel feliz about a promotion but also guilty para getting it sobre a close colleague. Which term describes this emotional conflict?
q_vocab_b2_11_009.explanation: 'Sentimientos encontrados' significa 'mixed feelings' y 'ambivalencia emocional' significa 'emotional ambivalence'. Estos terms describir el/la experience de having contradictory emotions simultaneously.
q_vocab_b2_11_009.context: Personal conversation about conflicting emotions after a workplace promotion

q_vocab_b2_11_010.question: Alguien describes feeling a sudden, intense wave de sadness without any apparent cause. Which nuanced Español expression best captures this experience?
wrong: Se sentía muy enfadado con alguien.
q_vocab_b2_11_010.explanation: 'Le invadió una tristeza inexplicable' significa 'An inexplicable sadness washed sobre them.' El verbo 'invadir' (a invade) conveys el/la sudden, overwhelming nature del emotion.
q_vocab_b2_11_010.context: Describing a complex emotional experience to a therapist

q_vocab_b2_12_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'el tribunal' ?
q_vocab_b2_12_001.explanation: 'El tribunal' significa 'court' o 'tribunal', el/la judicial body donde legal cases son heard y decided.

q_vocab_b2_12_002.question: El abogado presentó las pruebas ante el ___.
q_vocab_b2_12_002.explanation: 'Juez' significa 'judge'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la lawyer presented el/la evidence antes de el/la judge.' El/la judge presides sobre court proceedings.

q_vocab_b2_12_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'el contrato' en legal terminology?
q_vocab_b2_12_003.explanation: 'El contrato' significa 'contract', a legally binding agreement between two o more parties eso establishes obligations y rights.

q_vocab_b2_12_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'el demandante' ?
q_vocab_b2_12_004.explanation: 'El demandante' significa 'el/la plaintiff' o 'claimant', el/la persona quién brings a case against another en a court de law. El/la opposite es 'el demandado' (el/la defendant).

q_vocab_b2_12_005.question: verdict
q_vocab_b2_12_005.explanation: 'Verdict' translates a 'el veredicto' en español. Ello es el/la formal decision hizo por a jury o judge en el/la end de a trial.

q_vocab_b2_12_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'la demanda' en a legal context?
q_vocab_b2_12_006.explanation: 'La demanda' en legal contexts significa 'lawsuit' o 'legal claim'. 'Interponer una demanda' significa 'a file a lawsuit'. En everyday idioma, 'demanda' can también significar 'demand'.

q_vocab_b2_12_007.question: A person tiene been wrongly accused and needs legal representation. What should they do?
q_vocab_b2_12_007.correct: Contratar a un abogado defensor para que les represente.
wrong: Representarse a sí mismos sin conocimiento legal.
Huir del país para evitar el juicio.
q_vocab_b2_12_007.explanation: 'Un abogado defensor' significa 'a defense attorney'. Todos tiene el/la correcto a legal representation, especialmente cuando wrongly accused.
q_vocab_b2_12_007.context: Criminal justice system -- a person needing legal help

q_vocab_b2_12_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'la sentencia' en a legal context?
q_vocab_b2_12_008.explanation: 'La sentencia' en legal contexts significa 'sentence' o 'court ruling', el/la formal judgment handed down por a court, including cualquier punishment.

q_vocab_b2_12_009.question: la cláusula del contrato
q_vocab_b2_12_009.explanation: 'La cláusula del contrato' significa 'el/la clause del contract', a specific provision o condition within a legal agreement.

q_vocab_b2_12_010.question: A tenant discovers that their landlord tiene violated the rental agreement. ¿Qué es the most appropriate legal action?
q_vocab_b2_12_010.correct: Presentar una reclamación formal por incumplimiento de contrato.
wrong: Dejar de pagar el alquiler sin aviso.
q_vocab_b2_12_010.explanation: 'Incumplimiento de contrato' significa 'breach de contract'. Filing a formal claim es el/la proper legal recourse cuando el/la other party violates agreement terms.
q_vocab_b2_12_010.context: Tenant-landlord dispute over rental agreement violations

q_vocab_b2_13_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'la inversión' en finance?
q_vocab_b2_13_001.explanation: 'La inversión' significa 'investment', el/la act de putting money into financial assets, businesses, o projects with el/la expectation de generating profit.

q_vocab_b2_13_002.question: ¿Qué significa 'la inflación' ?
q_vocab_b2_13_002.explanation: 'La inflación' significa 'inflation', el/la rate en cual el/la general level de prices para goods y services rises, reducing purchasing power.

q_vocab_b2_13_003.question: El banco central decidió subir los tipos de ___.
q_vocab_b2_13_003.explanation: 'Tipos de interés' significa 'interest rates'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la central bank decided a raise interest rates.' Central banks adjust rates a control inflation.

q_vocab_b2_13_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la bolsa de valores' ?
q_vocab_b2_13_004.explanation: 'La bolsa de valores' significa 'stock exchange' o 'stock market', el/la marketplace donde shares de publicly traded companies son bought y sold.

q_vocab_b2_13_005.question: ¿Qué significa 'la rentabilidad' ?
q_vocab_b2_13_005.explanation: 'La rentabilidad' significa 'profitability' o 'return en investment (ROI)', a measure de cómo mucho profit es generated relative al amount invested.

q_vocab_b2_13_006.question: tax
q_vocab_b2_13_006.explanation: 'Tax' translates a 'el impuesto'. No confuse with 'impulso' (impulse), 'impacto' (impact), o 'importe' (amount/total).

q_vocab_b2_13_007.question: Which Español term refers a the total value de all goods and services produced por a country en a años?
q_vocab_b2_13_007.explanation: 'El producto interior bruto' (PIB) significa 'gross domestic product' (GDP). Ello es el/la primary indicator se usa para measure el/la health y size de a country's economy.

q_vocab_b2_13_008.question: la hipoteca
q_vocab_b2_13_008.explanation: 'La hipoteca' significa 'mortgage', a loan taken a purchase property donde el/la property itself serves as collateral para el/la loan.

q_vocab_b2_13_009.question: An investor wants a reduce risk por not putting all their money en one type de asset. What strategy should they follow?
wrong: Invertir todo en una sola empresa.
Retirar todo el dinero del mercado.
Pedir un préstamo para invertir más.
q_vocab_b2_13_009.explanation: 'Diversificar la cartera de inversiones' significa 'a diversify el/la investment portfolio'. Spreading investments across different asset types reduces overall risk.
q_vocab_b2_13_009.context: Financial advisor meeting with a client about investment strategy

q_vocab_b2_13_010.question: A country's currency tiene lost 30% de its value en six months. What economic phenomenon is occurring?
q_vocab_b2_13_010.correct: Una devaluación de la moneda nacional.
q_vocab_b2_13_010.explanation: 'Devaluación de la moneda' significa 'currency devaluation'. Cuando a currency loses significant value, imports become more expensive y el/la country's purchasing power decreases.
q_vocab_b2_13_010.context: Economic news report about currency crisis

q_vocab_b2_14_001.question: ¿Qué significa 'el eslogan' ?
q_vocab_b2_14_001.explanation: 'El eslogan' (también 'el eslogan publicitario') significa 'slogan', a short, memorable frase se usa en advertising a promote a product, brand, o es decir.

q_vocab_b2_14_002.question: La empresa lanzó una ___ publicitaria en redes sociales.
q_vocab_b2_14_002.explanation: 'Campaña publicitaria' significa 'advertising campaign'. El/la sentence significa 'El/la company launched an advertising campaign en social media.' No confuse 'campaña' (campaign) with 'campana' (bell).

q_vocab_b2_14_003.question: ¿Qué significa 'el público objetivo' en marketing?
q_vocab_b2_14_003.explanation: 'El público objetivo' significa 'target audience', el/la specific group de consumers eso a marketing campaign es designed a reach y influence.

q_vocab_b2_14_004.question: ¿Qué significa 'la marca' en advertising?
q_vocab_b2_14_004.explanation: 'La marca' significa 'brand', el/la identificaing name, symbol, o design eso distinguishes a product o company from competitors.

q_vocab_b2_14_005.question: commercial / advertisement
q_vocab_b2_14_005.explanation: 'Commercial' o 'advertisement' translates a 'el anuncio publicitario' (o simplemente 'el anuncio'). Ello se refiere a a paid message en media a promote a product o service.

q_vocab_b2_14_006.question: ¿Qué significa 'el patrocinador' ?
q_vocab_b2_14_006.explanation: 'El patrocinador' significa 'sponsor', a persona o organization eso provides financial support para an event, activity, o media content, normalmente en exchange para advertising.

q_vocab_b2_14_007.question: A marketing team wants a evaluate whether their reciente ad campaign was successful. What metric should they analyze?
q_vocab_b2_14_007.correct: El retorno de la inversión publicitaria (ROI).
wrong: El número de empleados en la empresa.
El color del logotipo de la marca.
q_vocab_b2_14_007.explanation: 'El retorno de la inversión publicitaria' significa 'return en advertising investment'. ROI measures el/la revenue generated relative al cost del campaign a assess su effectiveness.

q_vocab_b2_14_008.question: ¿Qué significa 'la difusión mediática' ?
q_vocab_b2_14_008.explanation: 'La difusión mediática' significa 'media coverage' o 'media dissemination', el/la extent a cual information es spread through various media channels.

q_vocab_b2_14_009.question: el consumidor
q_vocab_b2_14_009.explanation: 'El consumidor' significa 'consumer', a persona quién purchases y uses goods o services. Understanding consumer behavior es central a advertising y marketing.

q_vocab_b2_14_010.question: A brand discovers that negativo reviews about their product are going viral en social media. What should their communications team do first?
q_vocab_b2_14_010.correct: Emitir un comunicado oficial abordando las quejas de los consumidores.
wrong: Eliminar todos los comentarios negativos sin responder.
Atacar públicamente a los clientes insatisfechos.
q_vocab_b2_14_010.explanation: 'Emitir un comunicado oficial' significa 'a issue an official statement'. Addressing consumer complaints transparently es essential para crisis management y protecting brand reputation.
q_vocab_b2_14_010.context: Brand reputation crisis management on social media
